messages:
asha (CS): OrbitPayments submitted a bespoke SIG/CAIQ addendum asking for a 'key provenance' PDF + HSM attestation OR a consolidated KMS evidence bundle. They also requested a 3-year audit export (CSV) of admin actions. They attempted the export and got a 401 on `/admin/export` — request id rwd-2048-xyz. Due EOD Fri. @ben @jamie can you confirm what artifacts we can produce and whether the 401 is on our side?

ben (Solutions): Ack. Pinging @luca for the 401 repro and @jamie for attestation options. Do we have a standard 'provenance' template or is this bespoke for OrbitPayments?

luca (SRE): I can repro the 401. Quick repro steps:
``
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/export" -d '{"from":"2020-01-01","to":"2023-12-31"}'
```
Response: 401, body: {"error":"insufficient_scope","required":"org.admin"}
Looks like their token lacks org-level admin scope. Request id from our logs: rwd-2048-xyz (matches). If they used a personal token it won't work for exports covering org-wide data. Workarounds: 1) generate a support-scoped export token (I can run it), or 2) customer uses an org admin token (preferred).

jamie (Security): For attestation: we don't publish a signed 'HSM attestation' for hosted customers. We can provide:
- KMS key metadata (key IDs, creation/rotation timestamps)
- rotation ledger (signed audit entries)
- vendor cert chain for HSM/KMS provider
- export of access grant events for the keys
If OrbitPayments is on Private or Dedicated with HSM, we can provide a vendor-signed attestation PDF (legal review required). Which of these will satisfy their security team?

asha (CS): Customer replied that their security team wants a single PDF 'key provenance statement' plus the CSV export. They said 'if you cannot provide HSM attestation, KMS key metadata + signed rotation log + vendor certs will be acceptable'. Deadline EOD Fri. Can we commit to delivering the bundle and the sample CSV by then? If not, what's ETA?

ben (Solutions): We can produce key metadata + rotation log + sample CSV by Tue EOD. Signed vendor attestation PDF is only possible for Private/Dedicated (and needs legal signoff) — estimated 2 weeks. For the 401: tell customer to retry with an org admin token or allow support to create a temporary scoped token. If they agree I can spin a token now.

luca (SRE): I'm running a redacted export using a support-scoped token now to validate CSV schema. I'll attach a sample in a minute.

luca (SRE): Sample CSV (redacted):
```
timestamp,request_id,actor_email,action,resource,detail
2022-11-12T14:05:23Z,rwd-2048-xyz,alice@orbitpay.com,export_started,/admin/export,{"from":"2020-01-01","to":"2023-12-31"}
2022-11-12T14:05:25Z,rwd-2048-xyz,system,export_completed,/admin/export,{"rows":482}
```
Fields: timestamp, request_id, actor_email, action, resource, detail.

asha (CS): Thanks — I'll share the CSV sample and the proposed artifacts list with OrbitPayments and ask if they accept that in place of an HSM PDF. @jamie can you assemble vendor cert bundle + rotation ledger wording? Also please include the phrase we'll use for 'key provenance' so security can copy into their questionnaire.

jamie (Security): On it. Draft wording: "Redwood-managed keys are generated and managed within our KMS. Keys are rotated per our documented rotation policy; rotation and access events are logged and can be exported. For hosted customers, vendor cert chains and signed rotation ledgers are provided as evidence. HSM vendor-signed attestations are available for Private/Dedicated deployments under a customer agreement." I'll prepare the bundle and share EOD Mon, cc legal.

orbit-cust-bot: Thanks for the quick follow-up. If you can provide the artifacts + CSV sample by Mon EOD (UTC), we'll accept that and close this questionnaire. Please confirm timezone.

asha (CS): Confirmed — we'll aim Mon EOD UTC for the evidence bundle and CSV sample. I'll update OrbitPayments and mark this as high priority.
